# Vendored Mol*

This directory contains the browser distribution of **Mol* 5.4.2** used by
the Matter Frontier Lab biomolecular-structure workspace.

- Upstream: <https://github.com/molstar/molstar>
- Version: `5.4.2`
- License: MIT; the upstream license text is preserved in `LICENSE`.
- Included files: `molstar.js` and `molstar.css` from the published `molstar`
  package.

The viewer code is served locally. Experimental structures and predicted
models are fetched only after an explicit PDB or AlphaFold DB selection and
retain their upstream provenance in the interface.
